snippet.title: Webinar: Designing OT Networks for IT/OT Convergence
snippet.description:
Bridging IT and OT networks requires more than basic switching—it requires purpose-built network design for industrial realities.

As industrial environments become more connected, OT networks must support modern IT practices without compromising safety, reliability, or performance (SRP). Commercial-grade networking solutions often lack the resilience, recovery behavior, and protocol awareness needed for mission-critical OT applications.

In this session, we will examine how Moxa industrial switching is designed specifically for IT and OT convergence. You will learn how industrial-grade hardware, fast self-healing mechanisms, and OT protocol awareness work together to maintain deterministic performance and consistent uptime, even in harsh and high-availability environments.

Using real world examples, we will show how engineers can integrate IT and OT networks while strengthening operational resilience, improving fault recovery, and supporting long-term system reliability.

Key Takeaways:
• See why industrial switching matters for IT and OT convergence, and how OT focused design differs from commercial-grade networking.
• Understand how fast self-healing recovery and protocol awareness help maintain Safety, Reliability, and Performance (SRP) in mission-critical OT networks.
• Learn how engineers are deploying converged IT and OT networks to improve uptime, simplify operations, and increase long-term resilience.
• Identify practical design considerations for supporting mixed IT and OT traffic without sacrificing determinism or reliability.

Learn more: https://pages.moxa.com/us-2026-IT-OT-Convergence-Webinar.html?utm_medium=video&utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=202606-it-ot-convergence
